A higher modulus of elasticity indicates that the material is stiffer and less likely to deform under load, while a lower modulus of elasticity indicates that the material is more flexible and more likely to deform under load.

The modulus of elasticity is an important material property in engineering and materials science, as it is used to design and analyze structures and components subjected to external forces.
